title: Shell-Resolved SAA Magnetic Minimum
objective: Resolve the dynamic magnetic phase zero using the encoded epoch and the shell-provided radius.
negative_results: The parametric SAA minimum is DERIVED_MATHEMATICS over an OPERATOR_SELECTION parameter set — a modelled candidate region, not a measured geomagnetic field value.
The shell supplies the radius; altitude is never reported missing when a shell is present (reuses claims.refuse_altitude_missing_when_shell_present).
Outputs carry a non-zero uncertainty region (never invented precision); requests outside model validity are refused rather than extrapolated.

claims.statement: The SAA minimum position drifts with epoch AND shifts with the shell-supplied radius; both dependencies are live (POWER).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public model constants only; no private reads, no personal names or paths.
